title: delete confirmation does not name the record and confirms with a neutral "Continue" — the destructive alert-dialog variant is not used
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect on a destructive action — `reach:` row delete on any object list, measured; separate card under the maintainer's quota exception (provenance below).
Reader: objectui triage first-touch → `domain:ui` lane (`packages/plugin-view`, `packages/core` `recordDelete`); one PR.
Dedup (semantic search, open + closed, objectui): "delete confirmation dialog does not name the record, generic Confirm Action Continue button not destructive" → 9 hits, all closed; objectui#8978 added the destructive (red) confirm button to `alert-dialog`, objectui#11001 moved the detail-page delete onto the in-app dialog; none covers this dialog's copy or button.

Environment: framework `ce577ec4` showcase booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on its own port and SQLite file; console = objectui `f9f4a62d` (`apps/console` Vite dev server, and a production `vite build` for timings); Chromium 141 headless, 1440×900, seeded admin.

## Repro

1. Showcase → Data Model → Products → a row's "⋮" menu → Delete.
2. Actual dialog: title "Confirm Action", body "Are you sure you want to delete this record?", buttons "Cancel" / "Continue" — the confirming button is the default (primary) style, not destructive, and nothing names which record (here "QA Widget 0") or that the action is a delete.
3. Clicking "Continue" deletes the row (verified via `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_product`).

## Where

`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `deleteConfirmDialog`: title `actionConfirm.title` ("Confirm Action"), confirm `actionConfirm.confirm` ("Continue"), body `recordDelete.confirmText(…, deleteRequest?.records[0])` (`packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts`) — the record is in hand but its name is not used. The detail page's delete reads the same generic text (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`).

## Expected

A delete confirm says what is deleted ("Delete Product "QA Widget 0"?", bulk: "Delete 3 Tasks?") and confirms with a destructive-styled "Delete" button.

Provenance: filed as a separate card on the maintainer's explicit instruction in the dispatching session, which lifts the per-fire filing quota for this batch of seven, verbatim — 「重新思考以上和用户体验相关的问题，哪些需要立卡」 then 「分开立 7 张」. Found during a browser dogfood sweep of the console; companion checklist card objectstack-ai/objectui#11672. Filed by session `session_01WEARdKfDHDT7rTuEhLyT1k`.
